title: Release the first anchor
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose the forward and find-mode settings, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any body configuration $c$ on $x$, Boolean word $w$, and fuel configuration $f$ on $x$, one step of the loop host from the startup call on the halted version of $c$, with release clear and stop flag false, equals the non-startup call on $c$ with its state set to $a$, release set, and no stop flag, retaining $w$ and $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite machines B and F
replaced:
Let $c$ be a body configuration, $w$ a counter word, and $f$ a fuel configuration. One
step of the loop host from the startup call on $c$ with control removed, release clear,
and flag $\mathrm{false}$ yields the active (non-startup) call on $c$ with control the
anchor, release set, and no flag, changing no body, counter, or fuel data.
